1103747.rationale: The latest Reown Solana adapter depends on @solana/spl-token, which transitively includes bigint-buffer without a patched release. Swap Assistant uses the adapter only in client code, where bigint-buffer resolves to its pure-JavaScript browser implementation, and our Solana execution path does not call the affected native conversion function. Reassess before expiry or immediately when Reown removes the dependency.
